title: Sable and the Safehouse
author: Dominic Delacroix
blurb: Coral Brightwater, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
